blocks.text: South Korean police referred Kim Sung-woo, 26, to the Public Prosecution Service on Tuesday on suspicion of killing his mother-in-law and abducting his wife. Kim’s name and mugshot were released Monday. He is accused of stabbing his mother-in-law at her home in Songpa-gu, southern Seoul, at around 5:35 a.m. on Oct. 11, as she tried to stop him from forcibly taking his wife. Kim allegedly forced his wife into his car and drove her to a mountain in Yangyang, Gangwon Province, where he held her against her will.
